Messages.Author: Trigger
Messages.Body:
I gues I never thought of it but since an Ally is a Minion, can an Ally play an Action, Equipment, or Retainer card OR call a referendum if there is no requirements?

Can swap equipment as well?

Messages.Author: kombainas
Messages.Body:
Rulebook 6.1
>
> Instead of taking a default action, a ready minion could play an action card to perform the action indicated on the card.
>
> To equip with an equipment card from your hand, play the card and tap the acting minion.
>
> To employ a retainer from your hand, play the card and tap the acting minion.
>
In case you wondered...
>
> To recruit an ally from your hand, play the card and tap the acting minion.
>
But for Political Actions...
>
> A political action is an action that is used to call a referendum. It has a default +1 stealth and can only be taken by vampires (allies cannot call referendums).
>
Sabbat. If this vampire's bleed is successful, he laughs manicly and untaps.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
And minions you control can "borrow" equipment from other minions you control (it doesn't require to be a vampire).
